summary: Comprehensive testing of Calendar Management feature. Backend: 15/15 API tests passed. Frontend: All calendar features verified working including week/month views, add-on sidebar, schedule form, detail panel, and action buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: Draggable schedule blocks intercept pointer events - requires force=True for Playwright clicks, but works correctly for users
Calendar.jsx is well-structured with proper data-testid attributes for testing
seed_data_creation: Test patients TEST_CAL_* created and cleaned up during backend tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Calendar management fully implemented with @dnd-kit drag-and-drop. PATCH /api/patients/{mrn}/calendar endpoint handles schedule, move_to_addon, cancel, reschedule actions. Activity logs and audit logs are created for all actions. Week view shows 6AM-6PM time slots, month view shows patient names on days.

api_schedule_action.details: PATCH /api/patients/{mrn}/calendar with action=schedule sets status, date, time, room correctly

api_move_to_addon_action.details: PATCH /api/patients/{mrn}/calendar with action=move_to_addon clears schedule and sets add-on status

api_cancel_action.details: PATCH /api/patients/{mrn}/calendar with action=cancel removes schedule and sets cancelled status

api_reschedule_action.details: PATCH /api/patients/{mrn}/calendar with action=reschedule changes date/time correctly

api_activity_log_creation.details: Calendar actions create activity log entries on patient record

api_audit_log_creation.details: Calendar actions create audit log entries (internal)

week_view_time_slots.details: Week view shows 182 time slots (6AM-6PM, 30-min increments, 7 days)

week_view_day_headers.details: Week view shows day headers with date numbers and case counts

month_view_grid.details: Month view shows 35 day cells with patient names on correct days

addon_sidebar.details: Add-On List sidebar shows 8 draggable patient cards

detail_panel_opens.details: Clicking scheduled patient opens detail panel with patient info

detail_panel_move_addon_btn.details: Detail panel has Move to Add-On List button

detail_panel_cancel_btn.details: Detail panel has Cancel Case button with confirmation dialog

schedule_form_modal.details: Clicking empty time slot opens schedule form with date/time pre-filled

schedule_form_fields.details: Schedule form has patient search, date, time, OR room, duration fields

stats_row.details: Stats row shows Scheduled (13), Today (0), Add-Ons (8)

notes: All calendar management features implemented correctly. The /api/conferences endpoint returns 200 with data. Navigation arrows and Today button work. Context menu not explicitly tested but code review shows it's implemented. Drag-and-drop uses @dnd-kit library (already installed).
